source.rationale: Measured masses of the task objects, weighed on a scale. Layouts and compiled models are checked against this file, so a weight cannot disagree with itself in two places.
source.how_to_measure: Through MujocoWorldBase, never mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path: robosuite's base.xml sets inertiagrouprange="0 0", so only group-0 hulls carry mass and a standalone compile counts the group-1 visual shell as well.
